news.headline: Houthis strike Aden presidential palace, killing several people
news.body: Missiles and drones struck the Maashiq presidential palace complex in Aden on Oct. 15, officials said, killing and wounding multiple people while the prime minister was reported safe. The attack, which Yemeni and regional officials linked to the Iran-aligned Houthi movement, risks further escalating the wider regional conflict and disruption to shipping and oil infrastructure, Reuters reported.
